title: Project Update and Planning Meeting
discussion_points: Wireframe for the new onboard flow is complete but needs revisions based on design team feedback.
Mobile layout requires another round of revisions.
Back end development can start in parallel with API endpoint setup.
Current process for meeting notes is inefficient.
Proposal to build an AI meeting intelligence agent to automate meeting minutes and action item tracking.
Q3 budget review is scheduled for next Monday with department estimates due by Friday.
decisions: Sarah will revise the wireframe and hand it off to developers by Thursday.
Anas's team will start back end development in parallel.
Omar will develop a proof of concept for the meeting intelligence agent in two weeks.
Azure resources will be provisioned by tomorrow for Omar's project.
Anas will provide Omar access to the SharePoint templates library.
All department estimates for Q3 budget review must be submitted by Friday.
